AboutPage.metaDescription: Apercura publishes a free, factual page for every health practitioner registered in France, built from public open data.
AboutPage.title: About Apercura
AboutPage.lead: An open directory of every health practitioner in France, and a free booking tool for those who want one.

what.heading: What Apercura does
body: Apercura publishes a page for every doctor, dentist and midwife registered in France, built from the national register of health professionals and other public open data.

Patients find any practitioner, not only those who pay a platform. Practitioners can claim their page for free, check it and complete it. Free online booking, without a patient account, will open later.

principles.heading: Principles
list: Every practitioner is listed the same way, whether or not they use Apercura.
Factual information only: no ratings, no reviews, no ads and no paid ranking.
Free for practitioners and patients, with no subscription and no commission.
Each page shows where its facts come from and when they were last updated.
Minimal data, collected for a stated purpose and deleted on schedule.

how.heading: Where the pages come from
body: Pages are generated each week from the Annuaire Santé of the Agence du numérique en santé, the FINESS register of establishments and the Assurance Maladie directory. The data page lists every source, its licence and its date.

who.heading: Who runs Apercura
body: Apercura is a public-interest project. It is not a government service and is not affiliated with the Assurance Maladie, the Ordres or the Agence du numérique en santé.

OpenSourcePage.metaDescription: The full source code of Apercura is public under the AGPL-3.0 licence. Read it, audit it, or run the whole platform yourself.
OpenSourcePage.title: The code is public.
OpenSourcePage.lead: Every line of Apercura is published under the AGPL-3.0 licence: you can read it, audit it and run the whole platform yourself.

licence.heading: AGPL-3.0 licence

rules.heading: Which practitioners have a page
body: A practitioner has a public page when the register lists them with at least one activity open to patients (a practice, a health centre or a hospital) at an address. People without a fixed place of practice keep a record they can claim, but no public page.
Pages show facts only, in a neutral order: there are no ratings, no reviews and no paid ranking.

correct.heading: Correcting an error
body: Most facts come from registers kept by others, so the lasting fix is made at the source. The page follows at the next weekly import.
list: Name, profession, specialty, place of practice and phone: the practitioner updates their registration with their Ordre (or the body that registered them in the RPPS).
Agreement sector, OPTAM and Carte Vitale: they come from the Assurance Maladie directory (ameli.fr).
Name and address of an establishment: they come from the FINESS register, kept by the regional health agencies.
Practitioners can also claim their page from the practitioners’ area, then complete it and correct what is shown.
correct.formBody: Tell us what is wrong on a page. Your message is encrypted and read by the Apercura team only.

remove.heading: Objecting to a page
body: Under article 21 of the GDPR, a practitioner can object to the publication of their page. Apercura publishes the directory on the basis of a legitimate interest: informing the public from public data.

An unclaimed page will be hidden as soon as the request is received, then deleted after a light check of the request. A claimed page can be removed by its holder at any time. Once removed, a page does not come back with the next import.
remove.formTitle: Ask for the removal of a page
remove.formBody: For an unclaimed page. The page is hidden at once, then deleted after a light check. A claimed page is removed by its holder, from their space.

AccessibilityPage.metaDescription: Accessibility statement of Apercura (draft): compliance status with RGAA 4.1, test methods, how to report a problem and your recourse.
AccessibilityPage.title: Accessibility
AccessibilityPage.lead: Apercura is designed for everyone, including older and low-vision people. This draft statement says where it stands.

commitment.heading: Commitment
body: Apercura aims to comply with the French accessibility framework RGAA 4.1 and with WCAG 2.2 level AA on every page.
Patient pages use body text of at least 18 px, targets of at least 44 px, visible focus, and nothing conveyed by colour alone.

status.heading: Compliance status
body: Apercura has not been audited against RGAA 4.1 yet. Until an audit is published, the site is considered not compliant. A full audit is planned before launch.

tests.heading: How the pages are tested
list: Automated checks with axe-core on every type of page, in each release.
Keyboard-only checks of search and navigation.
Manual checks with the VoiceOver and NVDA screen readers are planned with the audit.

technologies.heading: Technologies used
body: HTML, CSS, WAI-ARIA and JavaScript. Search and the directory pages also work without JavaScript.

feedback.heading: Reporting a problem
body: If you cannot access a content or a service, tell us so we can provide an alternative or fix the page.

recourse.heading: Recourse
body: If you reported a problem and did not get a satisfactory answer, you can contact the Défenseur des droits.
list: Online form of the Défenseur des droits
Post (free, no stamp): Défenseur des droits, Libre réponse 71120, 75342 Paris CEDEX 07

PrivacyPage.metaDescription: How Apercura processes personal data: directory data from public registers, no patient data yet, no trackers, and your rights.
PrivacyPage.title: Privacy
PrivacyPage.lead: Apercura collects as little as it can. This draft explains what is processed, why, and how to exercise your rights.

roles.heading: Who is responsible
body: For the public directory, Apercura is the data controller. For online bookings, once they open, Apercura will process data on behalf of each practitioner, under a processing agreement included in the practitioners’ terms.

practitioners.heading: Data about practitioners
body: Directory pages show facts from public registers: name, profession, specialties, places of practice, published phone numbers and agreement sector. Each page names its sources and the date of its last update.

The legal basis is a legitimate interest: informing the public from public data. Practitioners are not informed one by one, which would be a disproportionate effort (article 14.5.b of the GDPR); the data page and a notice on each page inform them instead.
Every practitioner can object to the publication of their page.

patients.heading: Data about patients
body: Online booking is not open yet: Apercura does not collect any patient data today. When booking opens, it will ask only for what the practitioner needs, encrypt it at the application level and delete it on schedule (90 days after the appointment by default).

cookies.heading: Cookies and trackers
body: Apercura uses no advertising or audience cookies and no trackers. Only cookies strictly needed for the service may be set, so no consent banner is needed.

rights.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask to access, correct or erase data about you, and object to its processing. If you think your rights are not respected, you can file a complaint with the CNIL.

TermsPage.title: Terms of use
TermsPage.lead: These draft terms describe the service as it is today. They will be completed and reviewed before launch.

service.heading: The service
body: Apercura is a free directory of health practitioners registered in France, built from public open data. Using it requires no account.

content.heading: What the pages contain
body: Pages show factual information from public registers, in a neutral order. They carry no ratings, no reviews, no ads and no paid ranking.
The information can contain errors or be out of date: check it with the practitioner before travelling. Each page says how to report an error.

health.heading: Not medical advice
body: Apercura gives no medical advice and is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call 15 (SAMU) or 112.

practitioners.heading: For practitioners
body: Claiming a page will be free and will require proof of identity. A practitioner who claims a page is responsible for the information they add to it, which must stay factual, as the codes of medical ethics require.

ip.heading: Code and data
body: The source code is published under the AGPL-3.0 licence. Directory data is reused under the Licence Ouverte 2.0.

manage.missingBody: Open the link from your confirmation email again. If you copied it, make sure you copied all of it.
manage.invalidBody: The appointment may have been erased after its date, or the link was not copied in full. For any question, contact the practice.
manage.errorBody: Your appointment could not be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.

confirmEmail.body: The practice typed this address for you. Confirm that it is yours to receive reminders and changes by email.
confirmEmail.done: Thank you: your address is confirmed.

manage.rescheduled: Your appointment has been moved. A confirmation email is on its way.
manage.cancelConfirmBody: The time will be offered to other patients. This cannot be undone.
manage.cancelled: Your appointment is cancelled. A confirmation email is on its way.

manage.cutoffPassedMinutes: Online changes close {minutes} minutes before the appointment. To cancel or move it now, call the practice.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts from this connection. Wait a while, or call the practice.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This appointment could not be found.
errors.INVALID_SLOT: This time is no longer offered. Choose another one.
errors.BOOKING_DISABLED: Online changes are not available at the moment. Call the practice.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment, or call the practice.

manage.currentLegend: Your current time, {slot}, is marked “current” in the grid.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: This email address and password do not match.
errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address first: we have just sent you a new link.
errors.invalidCode: This code is not valid. Check the code and try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then sign in again.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password is too short: use at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password is too long: use at most 128 characters.
errors.userExists: An account already uses this email address. Sign in instead.
errors.mfaRequired: Confirm it is you with your second factor first.
errors.lastFactor: Add another second factor before removing this one: your account must always keep one.
errors.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be used. Try again, or use your password and code.
errors.accountFrozen: This account is frozen after a contest on a page. Contact us to recover it with a new identity verification.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Your practitioner space: your page, your agenda, your team.
signIn.asideFactor: Every account that can reach appointments needs a second factor: a code from an authenticator app or a passkey.
signIn.asidePasskey: A passkey is kept on your phone or computer and unlocked with your fingerprint, face or PIN.
signIn.passkeyHint: No password needed: your device confirms it is you.
signIn.totpLead: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown for Apercura.
signIn.backupLead: Each backup code works once. You received them when you set up your authenticator app.
signIn.pscHint: Once linked to your account from a claim, your e-CPS app or CPS card signs you in without another code.
signIn.psc: Sign in with Pro Santé Connect
signIn.pscFailed: Pro Santé Connect sign-in did not work. Link it to your account from your claim first, or sign in with your password.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: Free for practitioners and their assistants.
signUp.asideSteps: Three steps: create the account, confirm your email address, then set up a second factor.
signUp.asideFree: Creating an account does not change any public page. Claiming your page comes next.
signUp.name: First and last name
signUp.emailHint: We send a confirmation link to this address.
signUp.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long sentence is easy to remember.
signUp.sentTitle: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.
signUp.sentBody: Open the email and follow the link within an hour. Then sign in to set up your second factor.
signUp.sentHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or sign in: we will send a new link.

verifyEmail.title: Email confirmation
verifyEmail.successBody: Sign in with your password to set up your second factor.
verifyEmail.errorBody: It may have expired or been used already. Sign in: we will send you a new link.

challenge.title: Confirm it is you
challenge.lead: Your account has a second factor: use it to open your space.
challenge.aside: Your password alone is not enough to reach appointments.
challenge.passkeyLead: Your device asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN.
challenge.otherHeading: Not you, or no access to your factor?
challenge.otherLead: Sign out. Recovering an account means verifying your identity again.

security.title: Security
security.lead: How you sign in, and where you are signed in.
security.enrolLead: One last step before your space: set up a second factor.
security.enrolTitle: Choose a second factor to continue
security.enrolBody: Apercura asks every account that can reach appointments for one. An authenticator app or a passkey both work; you can add the other later.

totp.heading: Authenticator app
totp.lead: An app on your phone (for example FreeOTP, Aegis or Google Authenticator) shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.
totp.enabledTitle: The authenticator app is set up.
totp.enabledBody: You will be asked for a code each time you sign in with your password.
totp.scanLead: In your authenticator app, add an account and scan this code. If you cannot scan it, type the setup key.
totp.qrLabel: QR code to add Apercura to your authenticator app
totp.codesLead: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Print them or store them in a password manager; they are shown only now.
totp.confirmHeading: 3. Enter the code shown by the app
totp.passwordHint: We ask for it again before changing how you sign in.

passkeys.heading: Passkeys
passkeys.lead: A passkey stays on your phone, computer or security key and is unlocked with your fingerprint, face or PIN. Nothing to type, nothing to steal.
passkeys.name: Name

sessions.heading: Where you are signed in
sessions.lead: A session ends after 12 hours without use. Sign out any session you do not recognise.
sessions.everywhereHint: Lost a device or shared your password? Sign out of every session, this one included.

data.heading: Your data
data.lead: A copy of everything we hold about your account, and its deletion.
data.exportBody: A JSON file with your account, sign-in methods (never their secrets), sessions, practices, claims and page content.
data.deleteBody: Your account, sessions, claims and documents are deleted. Your page goes back to the facts of the register: unclaimed, without your content or photo.
data.close: Close the practice: its members lose access
data.practiceAlone: {name} is closed with your account (you are its only member).
data.confirmEmail: Type your email address to confirm
data.mismatch: This is not the email address of your account.
data.hasTeam: Choose what happens to each practice with a team.
data.lastAdmin: You are the last platform administrator: name another one first.
data.failed: The account could not be deleted. Try again in a moment.

app.title: Your space
app.emptyBody: Your practice appears here once your page is claimed and verified.
app.securityBody: Your account is protected by a second factor. Manage your authenticator app, passkeys and sessions.
app.agendaBody: Your day, your week, the requests to answer and the booking settings.
app.invitationBody: {practice} invites you to join its team.

email.footer: Apercura: the open directory of health practitioners in France. Free and open source.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.preview: Confirm your email address to finish creating your Apercura account.
verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.body: You have just created an Apercura account. Confirm that this address is yours to continue.
verify.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
verify.expiry: The link works for one hour.
verify.ignore: You did not create this account? Ignore this email: nothing will happen.

emails.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

claimRegistryLink.subject: Confirm the claim of a practitioner page
claimRegistryLink.title: Is this the practice of {practitioner}?
body: Someone has asked to manage the Apercura page of {practitioner}. This email was sent to the address the national register publishes for this practice.
If the request comes from {practitioner}, open the link and confirm it. The page is then verified.
notes: Not expected? Ignore this email: nothing changes and the page stays as it is.

claimReceived.subject: Your claim is in review
claimReceived.title: Your claim is in review
body: Hello {name},

We have received your claim and its documents. A member of the Apercura team will call the practice at the number published in the national register and ask for the code shown in your space. Keep it at hand.
We review claims within 48 hours on working days.

claimVerified.subject: Your page is verified
claimVerified.title: Your page is verified
body: Hello {name},
Your page now carries the verified stamp. Check the imported information, complete your fees and payment methods, then publish your page.

claimRejected.subject: Your claim was not accepted
claimRejected.title: Your claim was not accepted
body: Hello {name},
We could not verify your claim. Reason given by the reviewer: {reason}
You can open a new claim from your space, for instance with Pro Santé Connect.

claimSuperseded.subject: Your access to a page was withdrawn
claimSuperseded.title: Your access to a page was withdrawn
body: Hello {name},
Another account proved that it belongs to the practitioner of a page your account managed. Your account is frozen and its access to the practice was removed.
If you are the practitioner, contact us: your account can only be recovered with a new identity verification.

removalReceived.subject: Your removal request was received
removalReceived.title: Your removal request was received
body: The page is hidden from now on: it is no longer shown, indexed or listed.
We check the request, then delete the page. A deleted page does not come back with the next import of the register.

removalConfirmed.subject: The page was deleted
removalConfirmed.title: The page was deleted
body: The page you asked us to remove has been deleted from Apercura. It will not come back with the next import of the register.

removalRejected.subject: Your removal request was not accepted
removalRejected.title: Your removal request was not accepted
body: We could not confirm your removal request, so the page is shown again. Reason: {reason}
If you are the practitioner, you can also claim the page and remove it yourself from your space.

teamInvitation.subject: {inviter} invites you to join {practice}
teamInvitation.title: Join the team of {practice}
body: Hello,
{inviter} invites you to join {practice} on Apercura, as {role}.
To join, sign in or create your account with this email address, then set up a second factor (an authenticator app or a passkey): it protects the patients’ details you will see.
notes: You did not expect it? Ignore this email: nothing happens without you.

fees.fromOwner: The practitioner states the agreement sector and fees.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.TOO_MANY: Too many claims for today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.FROZEN: This account is frozen and cannot claim a page.
errors.NOT_FOUND: No page has this RPPS number.
errors.INVALID_RPPS: This RPPS number is not valid: it has 11 digits, the last one being a check digit.
errors.NOT_OPEN: This claim is closed: it can no longer change.
errors.METHOD_UNAVAILABLE: This method is not available for this page.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts with this method. Use another one.
errors.NOT_SUBMITTABLE: Add a document before sending the claim for review.
errors.BAD_DOCUMENT: This file cannot be used: send a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP of 10 MB at most.
errors.PSC_MISSING: Pro Santé Connect did not return an identity. Try again.

start.title: Claim your page
start.lead: A claim targets one RPPS number, never a name: homonyms cannot take each other's page.
start.contestTitle: This page already has a verified owner
start.contestBody: If it is yours (for instance you lost access to your account), you can still claim it: an administrator reviews the case, and Pro Santé Connect proves it fastest. Recovering an account always goes through a new identity verification.
start.confirm: This is me: start the claim
start.findHeading: Find your page by its RPPS number
start.notFound: No public page has this RPPS number yet.
start.rppsHint: 11 digits, printed on your CPS card and on your page.
start.searchHint: You can also look your page up by name:
start.howHeading: How we check that it is you
start.factorNote: Your account already has a second factor: it is required before any claim, and it protects your page from then on.

psc.title: Pro Santé Connect
psc.summary: With your e-CPS app or your CPS card. Verified at once, and online booking can open straight away.
psc.lead: Sign in with your e-CPS app or your CPS card. Your page is verified as soon as the identity matches its RPPS number.
psc.hint: You leave Apercura for the Pro Santé Connect page, then come back here.
psc.done: Pro Santé Connect confirmed your identity.

registry_email.title: The practice's email
registry_email.summary: A link sent to the email address the register publishes for your practice or health centre. Verified as soon as you open it; booking opens 7 days later.
registry_email.lead: We send a link to {email}, the address published in the register for your practice. Open it and confirm.
registry_email.sent: Link sent. It works for 24 hours.
registry_email.done: The practice's mailbox confirmed the claim.

document.title: A document and a phone call
document.summary: A photo of your CPS card or your registration certificate from your Ordre, then a call to the practice's number as published in the register. Reviewed within 48 hours; booking opens 7 days later.
document.lead: Send a photo of your CPS card or your registration certificate from your Ordre. It is encrypted before it is stored, and deleted 30 days after the decision.

phone_callback.title: Phone callback
phone_callback.lead: During the review, a member of our team calls the practice at {phone}, the number in the register (never a number you give us). Whoever answers reads out the code shown here.
phone_callback.hint: Show it when you are at the practice, or give it to whoever answers its phone. Asking for a new one cancels the previous one.
phone_callback.codeHint: Keep it on screen or note it down: for your security we only show it now.
phone_callback.done: The phone callback confirmed the claim.

lead.open: Prove that you are this practitioner with one of the methods below.
lead.superseded: This claim was withdrawn after a contest.

outcome.verified: Pro Santé Connect confirmed your identity: your page is verified.
outcome.passed: Pro Santé Connect confirmed your identity. An administrator now reviews the claim.
outcome.mismatch: The Pro Santé Connect identity does not match this page's RPPS number.
outcome.error: Pro Santé Connect could not be reached or the sign-in was cancelled. Try again.
outcome.linkedElsewhere: This Pro Santé Connect identity is already linked to another Apercura account. Sign in with Pro Santé Connect to use that account.

documents.hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB at most. Up to 4 files.

review.title: Send for review
review.lead: An administrator checks your document and calls the practice. You receive the answer by email, within 48 hours on working days.

status.bookingDelay: Without Pro Santé Connect, the 7-day waiting period before online booking ends on {date}.
status.contestReview: This page already had a verified owner: an administrator decides, and Pro Santé Connect proves it fastest.
status.reviewBody: Keep your callback code at hand: we call the practice at the number in the register.
status.superseded: This claim was withdrawn after a contest
status.contestTitle: This page already has a verified owner
status.contestBody: An administrator will decide. Pro Santé Connect proves your identity fastest; the other methods need a document and a callback.

emailLink.title: Confirm the claim
emailLink.lead: This link was sent to the email address the national register publishes for a practice.
emailLink.invalidBody: It expired (it works for 24 hours) or was already used. The practitioner can send a new one from their claim.
emailLink.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait an hour, then try again.
emailLink.doneBody: The practitioner can now sign in to complete the page.
emailLink.body: If the practitioner of this practice asked to manage their Apercura page, confirm it. Otherwise close this page: nothing changes.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw this claim?
withdrawDialog.body: The claim closes for good: its proofs stop counting and its documents are deleted 30 days from now. You can open a new claim later, starting again from the verification.

Onboarding.title: Set up your page
Onboarding.lead: Three steps to a complete page for {name}.
Onboarding.publishFailed: The page could not be published. Try again in a moment.

check.label: Check the imported information
check.title: Check the imported information
check.lead: Your page starts from the national register (Annuaire Santé). Check your name, profession and places of practice.
check.registryNote: Something wrong? The lasting fix is made with your Ordre, which updates the register; the page follows at the next weekly import. You can hide a place or add one in the page editor.

booking.label: Opening hours and booking
booking.title: Opening hours and booking
booking.lead: Patients book on your page once your agenda is open. Before it can open, your page must state your fees and the payment methods you accept.
booking.deontology: Article R.4127-53 of the public health code: a doctor who presents their activity online states their fees and the payment methods accepted.
booking.settingsNote: Places, opening hours and appointment types are set in the booking settings.
booking.settingsLink: Set up opening hours and booking

publish.label: Publish
publish.title: Publish your page
publish.lead: Publishing shows your presentation, languages, fees and practical information on your public page. You can change or hide them at any time.
publish.already: Your page is published. Every change you save is online at once.

Editor.title: Your page
Editor.lead: Complete the public page of {name}. Plain text only; what you hide is never shown.

empty.title: No page to edit yet
empty.body: Your page appears here once your claim is verified.

removed.title: Your page is removed from the directory
removed.body: Nobody can see it. You can restore it at the bottom of this page.

unpublished.title: Your content is not published yet

photo.title: Photo
photo.lead: Optional. A recent portrait, like an identity photo.
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB at most. We crop it square and remove its metadata (location, device).

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.lead: Factual information only: no testimonials, no comparisons (R.4127-19-1).
presentation.headline: Headline
presentation.headlineHint: One line under your profession, {max} characters at most.
presentation.bioHint: Plain text, {max} characters at most. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.

fees.title: Fees and health insurance
fees.lead: Required before online booking can open: your fees and the payment methods you accept.
fees.ameliPrefill: Prefilled from the Assurance Maladie directory. Your statement replaces it on your page.
fees.noteHint: For instance what extra fees depend on.
fees.requiredHint: Booking stays closed until at least one fee and one payment method are stated.

contact.title: Website and phone
contact.websiteHint: Your practice's site, starting with https://
contact.showPhoneHint: Hidden, the page no longer offers to call the practice.

failure.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
failure.invalid: Some fields need a correction: see the messages under them.
failure.lastSite: At least one place must stay shown: a page without a place cannot be published.
failure.unknownPlace: We do not know this postcode and town. Check them.
failure.badPhone: This phone number is not valid.
failure.photoTooLarge: This photo is larger than 5 MB.
failure.photoUnsupported: This file cannot be used as a photo: send a JPEG, PNG or WebP.

Editor.saved: Saved. Your public page is up to date.
Editor.savedDraft: Saved. Publish your page to show it.

sites.title: Places of practice
sites.lead: Choose which places your page shows. Places from the register can be hidden, not edited.
sites.registryNote: A registry place is wrong? Your Ordre corrects it in the register; the page follows at the next import.
sites.name: Name of the place
sites.phoneHint: The practice's number, shown on the page.

remove.title: Remove your page
remove.lead: Your page disappears from the directory, searches and search engines, and does not come back with the next import. You can restore it here.
remove.action: Remove my page from the directory

issues.markup: Plain text only: no HTML, no links in brackets.
issues.range: The upper amount must be greater than the amount.
issues.website: This address is not a website (https://…).

claims.title: Claims
claims.lead: Claims waiting for a decision. Contests come first.
claims.queueHeading: {count, plural, =0 {No claim waiting} one {# claim waiting} other {# claims waiting}}
claims.emptyBody: Claims sent for review appear here.

claim.title: Claim of {name}
claim.contestTitle: Contest: this page already has a verified owner
claim.contestPsc: The current owner was verified with Pro Santé Connect: only a claim verified with Pro Santé Connect can take the page over.
claim.contestBody: Approving gives the page to this account: the current owner's account is frozen and loses access to the practice.
claim.auditNote: Opening a document decrypts it and is recorded in the audit log, with your account and the time.
claim.phoneLead: Call one of these numbers from the register, never a number given by the claimant. Ask whoever answers for the code shown in the claimant's space.
claim.noCode: The claimant has not displayed a code yet.
claim.decisionLead: Approving verifies the page, creates the practice with the claimant as owner and emails them. Rejecting emails them the reason.
claim.codeHeard: Code read out by the practice
claim.codeLocked: Too many wrong codes: the claimant must show a new one.
claim.notApprovable: Approval needs Pro Santé Connect, the registry email, or a document and a successful phone callback (Pro Santé Connect in a contest against an owner verified with it).
claim.reasonHint: Say what is missing or wrong, plainly.
claim.decisionFailed: The decision could not be recorded. Reload the page and try again.

reports.title: Reports and removals
reports.lead: Removal requests (GDPR art. 21) and error reports sent from the public pages.
reports.failed: The action failed. Reload the page and try again.
reports.auditNote: Reading a request decrypts it and is recorded in the audit log.
reports.rejectReason: The request could not be confirmed.

Gdpr.rppsHint: 11 digits, printed at the top of the page.

errors.tooMany: Too many requests from this connection. Try again in an hour.
errors.notFound: No page has this RPPS number.
errors.claimed: This page is managed by its practitioner: only they can remove it, from their space.
errors.invalid: Check the form: a field is missing or too long.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

report.title: Report an error
report.lead: Tell us what is wrong on this page. Your message is encrypted and read by the Apercura team only.
report.doneTitle: Thank you, your report was received
report.doneBody: We check it. Facts from the register are corrected at the source; we tell you if you left an address.

kinds.impersonation: Someone is using this page in the practitioner's name

report.messageHint: What is wrong and, if you know, what is right.
report.privacy: Do not include any health information.

removal.metaTitle: Ask for the removal of a page · Apercura
removal.title: Ask for the removal of this page
removal.lead: Under article 21 of the GDPR you can object to the publication of your page. It is hidden as soon as we receive the request, then deleted after a light check.
removal.doneBody: It is no longer shown, indexed or listed. We check the request and confirm by email, then delete the page for good.
removal.contactHint: To confirm the request with you. It is encrypted and used for nothing else.
removal.messageHint: Anything that helps us check the request.
removal.confirm: I am the practitioner of this page
removal.privacy: A deleted page does not come back with the next import of the register.
removal.claimedTitle: This page is managed by its practitioner
removal.claimedBody: Only its holder can remove it, from the page editor of their space.
removal.claimedLink: Sign in to the practitioner space
removal.alreadyTitle: A removal request is being checked

common.accessLogged: Patient details on this page are decrypted for you, and each access is logged.
common.loadFailed: The agenda could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
common.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
common.refused: This change is no longer possible: the agenda changed in the meantime.
common.unreachable: Emails do not reach this patient: call them.
common.emailUnconfirmed: Email address waiting for the patient’s confirmation

noPractice.title: No agenda yet
noPractice.body: The agenda opens once your page is claimed and verified, or once a practice adds you to its team.

noCalendar.title: No place set up yet
noCalendar.bodyOwner: Set up the place where you see patients: opening hours and appointment types.
noCalendar.bodyStaff: The owner of the page has not set up the agenda yet.

requests.heading: Requests to answer
requests.lead: Patients wait for your answer. Unanswered requests lapse at the time shown.
requests.approved: Request accepted. The patient receives a confirmation.
requests.declined: Request declined. The patient is told by email.

week.title: Agenda
week.keyboardHint: Arrow keys move through the week, Enter adds or opens, Page Up and Page Down change the week.

add.title: Add to the agenda
add.emailHint: The first email only asks the patient to confirm this address. Details follow once confirmed, so a typo never sends them to a stranger.
add.taken: This time is already taken. Choose another time.
add.invalidEmail: Enter an email address such as name@example.fr, or leave it empty.
add.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number such as 06 12 34 56 78, or leave it empty.
add.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
add.outsideHours: Outside the opening hours: you can still add it.

entry.messageHint: Sent with the cancellation email, if the patient confirmed their address.

block.title: Block a time slot
block.lead: A meeting, an absence: patients cannot book this time.

settings.title: Booking settings
settings.lead: Places, opening hours, appointment types and the rules of online booking.

ownerOnly.title: Only the page owner sets up booking
ownerOnly.body: Your role lets you run the agenda. Opening hours and booking rules are set by the owner of the page.

gate.heading: Online booking
gate.ready: Your page meets the conditions: you can open online booking.
gate.fees: State your fees on your page.
gate.paymentMethods: State the payment methods you accept on your page.
gate.waitingPeriod: Your page was verified without Pro Santé Connect: booking can open on {date}.
gate.noType: Offer at least one appointment type online.
gate.noHours: Add opening hours or an extra opening.
gate.deontology: Article R.4127-53 of the public health code: a doctor who presents their activity online states their fees and the payment methods accepted.
gate.opened: Online booking is open. Patients can book on your page.
gate.paused: Online booking is paused. The agenda still works for the appointments you add.

places.heading: Places
places.lead: Each place has its own agenda, in the time zone of its department.
places.noZone: Unknown department: this place cannot take bookings yet.
places.presetsNote: It starts with the usual appointment types of your specialty: {names}.
places.none: No place of your page can take appointments. Add your practice address in the page editor.
places.addPlace: Add a place in the editor

types.heading: Appointment types
types.lead: Prefer neutral names: the type of an appointment can reveal health information.
types.name: Name

rules.heading: Weekly opening hours
rules.lead: The times patients can book, day by day. Several ranges per day are fine (a lunch break, for example).
rules.copyFor: Copy to the other weekdays, from {day}
rules.copied: {day} copied to the other weekdays. Save to apply.
rules.invalid: On {day}, each range must end after it starts and not overlap another.

exceptions.heading: Closures and extra openings
exceptions.lead: Holidays, an absence, or an extra morning: they win over the weekly hours.
exceptions.invalid: The end must come after the start.

booking.heading: Online booking rules
booking.minNoticeHint: Patients cannot book a time closer than this.
booking.horizonHint: How far ahead patients can book.
booking.step: Time between two possible start times (minutes)
booking.manualHint: Requests wait for your answer for up to 48 hours.
booking.askFirstVisit: Ask whether it is a first visit
booking.retentionHint: Between 30 and 365 days after the appointment. Apercura is not the medical record.
booking.instructionsHint: Plain text: the entrance, what to bring.

feed.heading: Private calendar feed
feed.lead: Follow this agenda in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Thunderbird. Anyone who has the link can read it: keep it to yourself.
feed.on: A feed link is active since {date}.
feed.urlHint: Shown only once: copy it into your calendar app now. Replacing it stops the old link.
feed.fullNames: Show patients’ full names in the feed
feed.fullNamesHint: Off by default: the feed then shows the appointment type and initials only, because your calendar provider’s servers read it.
feed.revoked: The feed is off: the old link no longer works.

log.title: Access log
log.lead: Each time patient details were decrypted: who, when, why and how many records. Nobody can change or delete it.

ownerOnly.title: Only the page owner reads the access log
ownerOnly.body: The access log of the practice is reserved to the owner of the page.

purpose.decrypt_volume: More than 500 records read within an hour

log.alert: On {date}, {name} read more than 500 patient records within an hour. Check that it was expected; if not, remove their access and change your password.

Team.title: Team
Team.lead: Invite the people who run your agenda. Each one signs in with their own account and a second factor.

ownerOnly.title: Only the page owner manages the team
ownerOnly.body: Ask the owner of the page to invite, change or remove a member.

roles.heading: Who can do what
roles.owner: Everything: the page, the team, the booking settings, the access log.
roles.practitioner: The agenda and the public page. Not the team, the booking settings or the access log.
roles.assistant: The agenda only: the day, the week, requests, appointments and blocks. Not the page, the team, the booking settings or the access log.

invite.heading: Invite someone
invite.sent: Invitation sent to {email}. It works for 48 hours.
invite.alreadyMember: This person is already in the team.
invite.rateLimited: Too many invitations today. Try again tomorrow.
invite.invalidEmail: Enter an email address such as name@example.fr.
invite.note: The invited person creates an account with this address, then sets up a second factor before joining.

members.heading: Members
members.removeBody: They lose access to the agenda at once. You can invite them again later.

other_address.title: This invitation is for another address
other_address.body: You are signed in as {email}. Sign in with the address the invitation was sent to.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations work for 48 hours. Ask {inviter} to send you a new one.

closed.title: This invitation is no longer valid
closed.body: It was withdrawn or already answered. Ask the practice for a new one if needed.

not_found.title: Invitation not found
not_found.body: Check the link in the email, or ask the practice for a new invitation.

errors.NO_SECOND_FACTOR: Set up a second factor before joining.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: You are already in this team.
errors.failed: Joining did not work. Try again in a moment.
